scope: src/lib/store.mjs undated and partial state handling
method: Read-only code/contract review with isolated in-memory adapter and mocked HTTP reproductions. No production code, policy, database, or source refresh changes.

findings.problem: The initial fingerprint removed all scripts. A new dated Event JSON-LD could leave a reviewedFragmentsOnly resource fingerprint unchanged, returning zero events with undated:true instead of requiring review.
findings.fix: The integrator now includes application/ld+json payloads from the entire document in the fingerprint, including head metadata. Ordinary volatile scripts remain excluded.
findings.snapshotEffect: Changed resource content is rejected as a complete snapshot. The refresher failure/partial paths preserve prior stored occurrences.
findings.regressionCoverage: tests/reviewed-resources.test.mjs tests both scoped and head Event JSON-LD additions.

transportChecks.allowlist: Only https://community.cmu.edu/s/sfsites/aura with one apex://EventFilterController/ACTION$getEvents action; non-null aura.token rejected.
transportChecks.redirectPolicy: manual redirect transport; every public POST redirect is rejected before following its destination.
transportChecks.limit: The public-list filter itself is being independently verified by the browser/API owner; this review does not bless the unfiltered 93-record response as equivalent to the 23 published public events.

stateAndPrecisionReview.partialAndUnsupported: Partial responses call mergePartial; unsupported/transport failures call failSource. Neither path deletes the previous occurrence snapshot.
stateAndPrecisionReview.undated: Only a complete zero-event resource response sets undated. Populated responses remain ok; dates recognized outside the window remain empty rather than undated.
stateAndPrecisionReview.dateOnly: Reviewed PwC banners use date-only starts and exclusive ends: April3–4,2024 ends April5; April26–27,2023 ends April28. No clock or timezone is invented.
stateAndPrecisionReview.futureDisclosure: Changed text, advertised media links or structured schedule metadata raises review; no monthly or biweekly recurrence is synthesized.

rootContractReview.assessment: No misclassification found. The primary workshop catalog and all three public booking pages are monitored as on-demand offerings, not scheduled empty calendars.

No misclassification found. The LCS ICS remains independently usable while the unavailable Manipulation ICS correctly keeps combined REAL coverage partial; historical records and TBD descriptions do not create upcoming events.
No misclassification found. Both date-bearing banners remain historical/outside-window with date-only precision; the redirected generic PwC calendar is not accepted as equivalent CMU scope.

independentlyExecuted: Reproduced the original JSON-LD false-undated failure.
Re-ran the same reproduction after the fix; changed content now reports unsupported:true and partial:true.
